default.title: PyTorch backend coming soon.
default.text: The PyTorch version of MEYELens is currently under development and is not yet available as a stable installation option.
default.small_text: For now, use the Default or TensorFlow backend for stable MEYELens installation.

default.title: GPU installation requires backend-specific setup.
default.text: GPU support depends on your operating system, CUDA version, GPU model, and installed drivers.
default.small_text: Install the GPU-enabled backend first, then run the MEYELens command shown below.

tensorflow.title: TensorFlow GPU installation requires a CUDA-compatible setup.
tensorflow.text: GPU support depends on your operating system, CUDA version, GPU model, and installed drivers.
tensorflow.small_text: Install the TensorFlow GPU requirements first, then run the MEYELens command shown below.
